design_rationale:
WHY THIS MAKES A GOOD TEST. A member rings to have his equity membership signed over to the family entity. That is the whole of his request, and it names no figure. The equity that moves, however, is not a field on the record: the recorded equity_balance of 15,200.53 is stale in the sense that matters, because the fiscal year most recently allocated has not been closed out properly on the books. The agent has to read three prerequisite sentences out of the equity policies, see in the ledger that none of the three states they wait on holds, work out which write brings each about, and land them in order before the transfer figure can even be formed. Along the way the number is decided by nineteen declared factors across four computations, reading the grain settlement statements and scale tickets, the crop input accounts and their prepay and past-due positions, the propane pre-buy position, and ten years of the equity ledger. Nothing here is a matter of choosing between similar tools: the four writes are the four problems, and the difficulty is discovering that three of them exist and getting each number exactly right on the world as it stands when it is written.

SCOPE. Task 0 is the first task of this difficulty, so nothing was occupied before it. It claims the whole of its tree: patronage_ext_year_end_unit_accrual, patronage_ext_allocation_restatement, patronage_ext_capital_retain and patronage_ext_membership_transfer_valuation, with the four tools book_qualifying_units_5a905387, restate_allocation_notice_7a44a997, record_capital_retain_31b65d0b and transfer_membership_equity_359bd53a. Reserved for task 1, whose draw is one prerequisite problem: the revolvement side of the domain (patronage_equity_revolved under patronage_revolvement and patronage_agg_equity_across_classes) and the retirement side (patronage_membership_retired under patronage_retirement), with their own tools. Nothing in task 0 touches a revolvement write or a retirement write, and nothing in task 1 touches an accrual, a restatement, a capital retain or a transfer, so the two scopes are disjoint and each remains load-bearing on its own.

THE STEP 0 DRAW, as printed by scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0003_farm_supply_and_grain_cooperative/tasks/member_equity_desk --task 0:
{"task": 0, "key": "farm_supply_and_grain_cooperative/member_equity_desk/0", "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 4, 6, 5]}
The tree therefore carries exactly three prerequisite problems, and the four computations take the four drawn factor counts: patronage_ext_year_end_unit_accrual takes 4, patronage_ext_capital_retain takes 4, patronage_ext_membership_transfer_valuation takes 6 and patronage_ext_allocation_restatement takes 5.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root: patronage_ext_membership_transfer_valuation, the problem the member's own request points at. It is a diamond: the root waits on both the capital retain and the restatement, and each of those waits on the year-end accrual.
 - root <- patronage_ext_capital_retain. kind value_input, gate retain_credits, form state. Prerequisite sentence, verbatim from the root's own rule: "The equity signed over is fixed only after the equity ledger carries the capital retain owed for the year most recently allocated." Four-point test: the ordering connective is "only after"; the side it waits on is a record-visible state, a capital retain line standing on the equity ledger for a named fiscal year, in the words the ledger and the ledger finder use; it names no tool, no policy id and no code token; and its strength is exactly the edge's, a hard requirement over one named year and no wider. Exactly one write in this difficulty brings that state about: the capital retain is the only policy whose subject is patronage_retain_withheld, so a reader who sees the state missing and reads the capital retain rule ("credited to the member's equity", "taken whether or not the board declares anything for the year") is led to exactly one action, record_capital_retain_31b65d0b, owner agent. Handling-time state (condition): a capital retain line for the fiscal year most recently allocated stands on the ledger. Seed evidence that it is false at the opening: initial_state.patronage_ledger carries retain rows for 2013 through 2024 and none for 2025, while initial_state.patronage_memberships.<membership>.last_allocation_year = 2025.
 - root <- patronage_ext_allocation_restatement. kind value_input, gate restated_allocation, form state. Sentence: "Before the equity signed over is worked out, the allocation standing for the year most recently allocated must be the allocation that year's own volume earns." Connective "Before"; the side it waits on is the record-visible state of the allocation standing for a year; no tool, id or code token; strength exactly the edge's. Exactly one write brings it about: the restatement is the only policy whose subject is patronage_allocation_adjusted. Condition: the allocation standing for the year rests on the volume the records support. False at the opening: notice PN-441225 stands posted on 38,500.00 grain bushels while the accrual rows already carry 41,800.00, and no adjusted row of any kind stands on the ledger.
 - patronage_ext_allocation_restatement <- patronage_ext_year_end_unit_accrual. kind value_input, gate accrual_sum, form state. Sentence: "A notice is restated only after every parcel of that year's qualifying business stands accrued on the equity ledger." Connective "only after"; record-visible state (accrual rows standing on the ledger); no names. One write brings it about: the year-end accrual is the only policy whose subject is patronage_units_accrued. False at the opening: the year's grain accrual rows carry 41,800.00 against 48,635.60 of qualifying volume on the settlement statements.
 - patronage_ext_capital_retain <- patronage_ext_year_end_unit_accrual. kind value_input, gate accrued_grain, form state. Sentence: "The capital retain for a year is worked out only once the equity ledger carries the whole of that year's qualifying volume on the streams the class lists." Connective "only once"; record-visible state; no names; and it is not identical to, and does not contain, any other prerequisite sentence in the charter. Same one resolving write. False at the opening for the same seeded reason.
All four edges are value_input, which is two more than the floor of max(3-1,1)=2. Topological order: accrual, restatement, retain, transfer. The parallel pair is argued in prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness and was replayed both ways to the same hash. Per-edge deletion sensitivity is recorded in prerequisite_closure.edge_load_bearing and was produced by the Step 5 run, each figure taken from an actual replay with that one write suppressed and everything else unchanged: 12,141.30 -> 12,018.74 (retain skipped), 12,141.30 -> 11,694.75 (restatement skipped), 4,896.78 -> 4,134.40 (accrual skipped, restatement side; the grain volume falls to 41,800.00 and five times the 9,500.00 unpriced bushels then exceeds it, so the holdback moves from ninety-five hundredths to eighty-five hundredths), 122.56 -> 105.34 (accrual skipped, retain side). The persona mentions no prerequisite (see prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint) and no tool validates one (see prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block).

BASE-INVARIANT CARD.
 - patronage_units_accrued is governed by patronage_evt_unit_accrual alone, which carries no structured eligibility; its scope of application is inherited whole - the basis natural to the business, the fiscal year fixed by the settlement date on the record, and nothing accruing on a programme that is not patronage-eligible. The extended policy declares one override against it: the base sentence "Grain marketed accrues on settled bushels rather than delivered bushels, so bushels delivered but still unpriced at the year end accrue in the year they are settled and not the year they were hauled" is superseded by the reach ladder, which gathers a late settlement back into the year it was hauled where a delayed price position stands open. That is a version update declared clause by clause; every other sentence of the base rule stays in force.
 - patronage_allocation_adjusted is governed by patronage_adjustment alone. The extended policy declares two overrides. The first is against patronage_cash_payment, whose clause "The cash portion is paid once per allocation notice, so a corrected notice is paid by a further row referencing the same notice and not by reissuing the first payment" is replaced by "A restatement is carried wholly through the member's equity account, and the cash portion already delivered on the notice restated is neither reworked nor reissued." That is what keeps the restatement from igniting a cash obligation this task set does not carry. The second is against patronage_adjustment itself: the clause "posts the allocation afresh at the rate declared for the year restated, never at this year's rate" is replaced by "Where the member's own programme standing earns a rate on a basis, that programme rate stands in place of the rate the notice carries for it." The departure is exactly the two programme tiers on the crop input and refined fuels rates; every other rate the computation uses, and every fall-through of those two ladders, is the rate the notice for the year restated carries, so the surviving half of the base sentence is honoured rather than quietly set aside. Neither superseded clause quotes the condition of the restatement-window gate, so that gate stays in force and is declared in base_preconditions. Its time gate restatement_within_window is inherited verbatim: anchor event "the current fiscal year", authoritative anchor patronage_ledger.entry_date, relation not_after, duration from variants.restatement_window_years (three for Class A), counting "in whole fiscal years back from the current fiscal year", boundary inclusive. At frozen_time 2026-01-15 the fiscal year now running is the one that began 1 September 2025. Positive case: notice PN-441225 is dated 2025-11-15 and belongs to fiscal year 2025, one year back, comfortably inside a three-year window. Negative case: a notice for fiscal year 2022 is four whole fiscal years back and is outside it, so the desk would leave it; fiscal year 2023, exactly three years back, is still inside because the boundary is inclusive. Both cases are written into solvability_contract.temporal_feasibility.
 - patronage_retain_withheld is governed by patronage_retain alone, which carries no structured eligibility. The class's own per-unit retain rate survives the override that retires the clause which used it, and is still the fall-through of the rate ladder: what an overwrite retires is the handling sentence, not a parameter value, and base's values remain valid and base-homed. The extended policy declares one override against it: the clause "taken separately at the class's retain rate on the qualifying units of the streams the class lists" is replaced by "The capital retain a member contributes is worked out on the volume the streams the class lists carry once the crop input spend has been taken at the share the member's buying account earns, at the rate the cooperative's books last retained at, and weighted by the member's standing in the cooperative." That one declaration covers all three departures the computation makes from the base clause - the rate taken from the ledger's latest retain line rather than the class catalogue, the crop input stream counting at the share a past-due account earns, and the weighting for standing - so none of them is an undeclared divergence. Every other sentence of patronage_retain stays in force and is inherited: the retain is taken whether or not the board declares anything for the year, it is credited to the member's equity balance, it revolves out on the same cycle, and it is never refunded on request. Those surviving sentences are what the policy_scope precondition on this write now quotes.
 - patronage_membership_transferred is governed by patronage_equity_transfer alone. Its authorization gate signed_transfer_instruction is inherited and satisfied before the write by a system record: initial_state.patronage_requests carries one row of type equity_transfer, signed_by_member true, request_status approved, correlated to the call through the request_id the tool takes. The extended policy declares one override against the same base policy: "A transfer moves equity at its face value with no discount, carries the class's transfer fee, and does not reset the allocation years behind the equity, so the transferee inherits the transferor's place in the revolvement cycle rather than starting afresh" is superseded by the sentence that adds the cash carried in and the stock redeemed and takes the offset, the recording charge and the certificate charge off the sum. The gate's own condition sentence is not quoted by that override, so the gate stays in force and is declared in base_preconditions.
 - patronage_ext_allocation_restatement also declares an override against patronage_cash_payment, whose clause "The cash portion is paid once per allocation notice, so a corrected notice is paid by a further row referencing the same notice and not by reissuing the first payment" is replaced by "A restatement is carried wholly through the member's equity account, and the cash portion already delivered on the notice restated is neither reworked nor reissued." That is what keeps the restatement from igniting a cash obligation this task set does not carry; patronage_cash_payment has no eligibility gates, so nothing is retired by the quotation.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. The narrowest object is the single equity membership MB-441207 of member M-44012, and within it the fiscal year most recently allocated, 2025, read off the membership's own last_allocation_year rather than assumed. The correlation keys are: the membership row id for every ledger write; notice_number PN-441225 for the restatement, which is the narrowest key back to one allocation notice and is what the base gate's action_bindings pin the write to; request_id for the transfer, the narrowest key back to one registered instruction. Rows that enter each aggregate: for the accrual, the FY2025 grain accrual rows (22,400.00 + 16,100.00 + 3,300.00) and the FY2025 grain notice line; for the restatement, those accrual rows plus the FY2025 input and energy accrual rows; for the retain, the same grain rows, the FY2025 input rows and the latest earlier retain row; for the transfer, every equity portion on every notice, every retain row, the restatement row and the revolvement row. Rows deliberately excluded: the 7,800.00-bushel settlement of 2024-07-22 falls outside the seventeen-month window and is the planted near-miss on the accrual; the 6,300.00-bushel settlement of 2025-12-18 belongs to the new fiscal year and is excluded by the reach; the 9,400.00 direct-ship bushels count, but at four fifths rather than in full; the FY2013 revolvement of 2,180.00 is the only equity that has left the account and is subtracted once. The only earlier settlement of an equity obligation on this membership is that revolvement, correlated to allocation year 2013 by its own fiscal_year field.

WHY EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW EXISTS.
 - customers: the member himself; remove it and there is no profile to locate or verify against.
 - patronage_memberships: the class fixes the equity split, the transfer fee, the minimum equity balance, the par value, the certificate rule and the retain rate; last_allocation_year fixes the year all four computations are anchored on; joined_date decides the stock redemption tier and half the retain rate tier; voting_rights decides the standing weighting; equity_balance is the recorded figure the valuation's second tier would read, and it is deliberately the ledger's opening figure rather than the true post-restatement one, so an agent who trusts the field lands 11,694.75 instead of 12,141.30.
 - patronage_ledger, 46 rows: twelve years of notices, retains and cash payments give the retain-rate tier (the latest rate is the board's 0.0028, not the class's 0.0030), the certificate tier (thirteen retain lines by the time the transfer is valued), the standing weighting (fifteen notices), the equity credits and the cash declared. The FY2025 notice at 38,500.00 bushels and 0.0425 against accrual rows of 41,800.00 is the whole shape of the case. The 3,300.00 accrual of 2025-12-02 is the parcel posted after the notice went out. The FY2013 revolvement is the only equity out. Five retain rows carry the board's later 0.0028 rate (fiscal 2020 through 2024), so removing any one of them leaves the rate at 0.0028 and the retain at 122.56; remove all five and the latest earlier rate becomes the class's own 0.0030, taking the retain to 131.32; remove the 2025-12-02 accrual and the shortfall the accrual write credits rises from 6,835.60 to 10,135.60, while the restatement and the retain are unmoved, because both read the accrual rows as they stand after that write.
 - patronage_requests: the signed, approved instruction is the base gate's evidence, so without it the transfer has no authority at all and the write must not be made; its date of 2026-01-06 also puts the recording charge on the prompt tier, nine days being well inside thirty. Both counterfactuals were replayed rather than reasoned: with the table emptied and everything else unchanged the charge falls back to the class's own fifty-dollar transfer fee and the scored figure becomes 12,116.30, and with the instruction dated 2025-11-20, fifty-six days before the call, the charge is forty dollars and the figure is 12,126.30.
 - grain_contracts and grain_ledger: the delayed price agreement with 9,500 unpriced bushels and a contract in delivering put the reach on its top tier; the settlements give the year's volume and, on the same band, the direct-ship share; the delivered loads give the out-of-condition volume; the unpriced position decides the restatement holdback. Two tickets are planted near-misses that the rule alone excludes: T-4412390 of 2025-10-05 is tough but falls after the year closed, so the conditioning ladder never sees it and the allowance rests on T-4412114 alone, and the two dry tickets are excluded by their condition flag. Remove the delivering contract and the reach falls to five months and the accrual drops to nothing.
 - agronomy_accounts and agronomy_invoices: the prepay account decides the crop input allocation rate; the past-due account decides that none of the crop input spend subscribes capital and supplies the 4,820.60 offset; the two invoices and the payment show the balance is a real unpaid balance and not a stale field; and the 2,400.00 program rebate on invoice IN-4412488, allowed on 2025-12-10 after the notice went out, is what puts the crop input volume the restatement rests on at 135,250.00 rather than the 137,650.00 the notice was posted on. Remove the rebate row and the restatement rises to 4,942.38 and the transfer to 12,173.22; date it outside the seventeen months the rule counts - 2023-12-10 on a replay - and it drops out of the read with exactly the same effect.
 - energy_accounts and energy_deliveries: the contract gallon pre-buy position with 1,750 gallons still owed decides the refined fuels rate, and the deliveries evidence that the gallons owed are real.
AUTOMATIC-CLAUSE CHECK. Base clauses that could ignite an obligation elsewhere were walked: the allocation minimum (25.00) is far below every figure here and never bites; the reporting threshold (600.00) is met on the notice already posted and is a reporting fact, not a write; the maximum equity balance (500,000.00) is nowhere near; the class's inactivity period is not reached because business accrues for 2025; the restatement is kept from creating a fresh cash obligation by the declared override on patronage_cash_payment; and the revolvement cycle's next eligible year is 2026, which the seed records but which nothing in this task is due to pay, because no revolvement obligation falls due before the fiscal year now running closes. CACHE. patronage_memberships.equity_balance is a genuine stale cache: it equals the ledger at the opening but not after the restatement and the retain, which is exactly the trap the valuation's second tier sets, and the persona carries the natural re-check line ("The last statement said one thing and I've never once been able to make that number work") without ever giving a figure.

PERSONA. Kirby is written as a man winding down who has already done his part at the counter and simply wants the last step finished; his voice is short, practical and faintly impatient, and the paragraph order follows how such a call actually runs - what he wants, who he is, what he does not know, and what he will do if asked. He volunteers only his membership number, his age, that he signed the papers and that the board approved them, all of which initial_state carries. Everything else is on request: the tax number's last four, the farm phone, the date he joined, the unpriced bushels, the past-due seasonal account, the prepay money and the contract gallons. He states no internal reference and says so if asked for one. His passive reactions are three and are written as speech rather than a script: he defers if told the books need putting right, he runs the transfer himself when it is handed to him and reads back what appears, and he closes once he hears the membership has been signed over. He never corrects a wrong figure and never names a further piece of work at the sign-off.

DIFFICULTY IN DEPTH AND BREADTH. Depth: surface goal (sign the membership over) -> the transfer valuation's own rule says the figure waits on the capital retain and on the allocation as restated -> the retain's rule says it waits on the year's whole qualifying volume standing accrued -> the restatement's rule says the same -> the accrual is the only write that brings that state about. Three hops, and the order cannot be swapped: the accrual changes the volume both middle problems rest on, and both middle problems change the equity the root values. Breadth: the four numbers together read four different product ledgers (grain settlements and scale tickets, crop input accounts, the propane pre-buy position, the equity ledger itself), two date spans (the seventeen-month window and the years since joining), and nineteen ladders, nine of which are decided from another difficulty's records - three on the grain ledger in the accrual, two on the crop input accounts and one each on the fuel account and the grain ledger in the restatement, one on the crop input accounts in the retain and one more in the transfer.

WHERE CARELESSNESS LOSES IT. Reading equity_balance off the membership instead of reconciling the ledger gives 11,694.75. Missing the reach and counting only settlements inside the calendar year gives an accrual of nothing. Counting ticket T-4412390 of 2025-10-05 among the year's out-of-condition bushels - a ticket the cooperative received after the year closed - takes the out-of-condition volume to 20,700.00, five times which exceeds the year's settled volume, and drops the conditioning allowance to nine hundred and eighty-five thousandths; the accrual then reads 6,346.80 and every figure after it moves, which is why the rule now says in terms which tickets are counted and that the reach gathers no ticket with it. Counting the 7,800.00-bushel settlement of 2024-07-22, which sits outside the window, or the 6,300.00 of 2025-12-18, which belongs to the new year, moves the volume. Taking the rates the notice carries and the volumes it was posted on, without the programme tiers or the rebate, gives 4,432.70 for the restatement - which is the allocation the notice already declared, so nothing would have needed restating at all. Forgetting that a past-due input account stops crop input spend subscribing capital gives a retain of 469.44. Forgetting the offset gives 16,961.90. Each of these is excluded by a sentence of the published policy read against a row of the records, not by a hint.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate the member from the membership number and clear identity on two profile details. Read the membership, the whole equity ledger, the equity requests, the grain contracts and ledger, the crop input accounts and invoices, and the refined fuels account and deliveries. Work out the year's qualifying grain volume (48,635.60) and credit the 6,835.60 the ledger is short. Restate notice PN-441225 on 48,635.60 bushels at 4,896.78. Take the FY2025 capital retain of 122.56. Then hand the transfer to the member, who signs the membership over at 12,141.30.

RULE AND COMPUTE, TWO WAYS. Forward: every binding of the four policies that reads the world, aggregates, chooses, caps or rounds carries a verbatim quotation in compute_basis; the sensitive words were cross-checked, so "in the seventeen months up to today" and "in the two months up to today" answer to within_months, "the accrual rows recorded for the year on the grain basis" answers to the fiscal_year and allocation_basis filters, "where ... the volume counts at four fifths" answers to a ternary, "where that difference would be less than nothing" answers to MX, and "rounded to two decimal places" answers to RND. Backward: every load-bearing sentence of each rule was pointed at the binding that implements it - the reach ladder at reach_months and settled_after_year, the participation ladder at direct_share, the conditioning ladder at conditioning_factor, the prior-accrual ladder at already_accrued, the crop input volume ladder at input_volume, the two programme rate ladders at input_rate and energy_rate, the holdback at holdback_share, the volume ladder at retain_volume, the crop input participation at input_share, the retain rate at retain_rate, the standing weighting at standing_share, the valuation ladder at equity_on_hand, the recording charge at recording_charge, the offset at offset_amount, the certificate charge at certificate_charge, the stock redemption at stock_credit and the cash carry at carried_cash. No sentence is unclaimed and no filter is unquoted. The order, the acting base, the moment of the floor and the rounding point are pinned in prose in each rule: the participation share acts before the conditioning allowance on the year's settled volume; each basis product is rounded before the three are added and the holdback then acts once on that sum, the rate for each basis being the one the notice for the year restated carries unless the member's programme standing earns another; the retain rate acts on the retain volume and the standing weighting acts on the rounded product; and the transfer adds the equity, the cash and the stock before taking the three deductions off and flooring at nothing.

ELIGIBILITY EVIDENCE AGAINST GOLD. The two structured gates are the restatement window and the signed transfer instruction. The first is satisfied by the notice row's own entry_date, fiscal_year, notice_number and adjustment_reason read at frozen_time, correlated to the write by the notice_number argument, which is the binding the base evidence_contract fixes. The second is satisfied by the request row's request_type, request_status, signed_by_member and request_id, correlated to the write by the request_id argument, again the binding the base contract fixes. Both are pre-action system records; the persona supplies neither. The other two writes are governed by base policies with no structured gate, and their policy_scope entries carry the inherited scope sentence and the seed rows that show it applies.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT. With the extended yaml, compute, expected, gold and this dossier masked, and working only from the policy prose that will be published, the tool schemas, the rows the share tools return and the persona's actual lines, the call was re-derived: the member's request selects the transfer; the transfer rule's own two sentences send the reader to the capital retain owed for 2025 and to the allocation standing for 2025; the ledger shows no 2025 retain row and a notice posted on 38,500.00 against accrual rows of 41,800.00; the retain rule and the restatement rule each send the reader to the year's whole qualifying volume standing accrued; the accrual rule works that volume out of the settlement statements as 48,635.60 and the ledger is short 6,835.60. Working forward again the same four numbers come out: 6,835.60, 4,896.78, 122.56 and 12,141.30, in that order, with the last handed to the member to run. No second reading of the published text reaches a different object, order or figure, and nothing in the derivation needed a value only the hidden assets carry.

REVISIONS. (1) Symptom: the capital retain's volume factor was decorative because the restatement volume and the accrual sum were the same number on this world. Root cause: the retain had been made to wait on the restatement, whose own volume is the accrual sum. Change: the retain now waits on the accrual directly, the tree became a diamond rather than a chain, and the retain's ladder falls through to the notice volume. Re-run: baseline 97.02 against 122.97, no longer decorative, and the accrual-skipped run moves the retain to 105.34. Propagated to the retain's rule, prerequisite sentence, compute, compute_basis, factor ladder and baseline, to the root's rule and second prerequisite edge, and to prerequisite_closure. (2) Symptom: the accrual's history reads were not load-bearing as a whole, because the tier taken read the notice through LATEST while the sum was unused. Root cause: the ladder's fall-through and its top tier were the wrong way round. Change: the fall-through now reads the notice and the top tier the accrual rows. Re-run: zeroing the history aggregates moves the accrual from 6,994.80 to 10,294.80. Propagated to the rule, compute, compute_basis, the factor ladder and the baseline paragraph. (3) Symptom: the transfer figure came out at nothing because the seeded past-due balance exceeded the equity. Change: the seasonal account's balance was set to 4,820.60 with an invoice and a payment behind it. Re-run: 12,147.44.

REVISIONS, ROUND 2 (after the source-layer policy-task audit). user_scenario:
Kirby Jorgenson farms about eighteen hundred acres of corn and beans north of Forest City with his brother's two boys, and he has been a member of Prairie Ridge since 2001. He is sixty-seven, he has been winding down for two seasons, and at the counter last week he signed the paperwork putting his equity account over to Jorgenson Brothers Farms, the family entity the boys now run. The board sat on the sixth of January and the girl at the counter rang him to say it had gone through. He is on the phone to the member services desk this morning to get it finished: he wants the desk to sign the whole membership over today. "I signed the transfer papers and the board's approved them," he says, "so I'd like the whole thing put across to the entity today - and if there's anything I have to put my own name to, hand it over and I'll do it while I'm on."

He gives his membership number, M-44012, straight away, because it is printed at the top of the patronage notice sitting in front of him. If the agent wants something more to prove who he is, he reads the last four of his tax number off the same notice, 4412; if they want more still, he gives the farm phone, 5150441182, and the date the board took him in, 2001-09-04. He offers none of it unless he is asked, and he does not know any internal reference numbers at all - he says so if anybody asks him for one.

He has no idea what the equity account comes to and says so cheerfully: "I couldn't tell you what's in it. The last statement said one thing and I've never once been able to make that number work." If the agent reads him a figure he takes it at face value; he has no arithmetic of his own to put against it and he will not argue. Asked about the corn still sitting on the delayed price agreement, he says there are bushels out there he never priced and he is not pricing them today. Asked about the input accounts, he admits the seasonal one got behind after the herbicide bill and he has not caught it up; asked about the prepay account, he says there is money sitting on it for spring. Asked about the propane, he says the tank is on contract gallons and he still has some of those left. Asked what he wants done about any of that, he says he only wants the membership moved; the rest can stay as it is.

He will not raise anything the desk has not raised first. If the agent tells him something has to be put right on the books before the figure can be worked out, he says "you do whatever the books need, that's your end of it" and waits. If the agent explains that signing the membership over is his own act and hands him the paperwork to run, he runs it there and then and reads back whatever comes up on the screen. Once he hears that the membership has been signed over he thanks them, says the boys will be pleased, and rings off; he asks for nothing else and names nothing else he wants done.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull up the member profile from the membership number the caller reads off his patronage notice, so the desk knows whose equity account is in question and holds his internal reference.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Without the profile there is no customer reference for the identity check and no way to reach the equity membership, the grain contracts, the crop input accounts or the refined fuels account the calculation reads.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record that the caller is the member whose equity account is about to be transacted on, matching the membership number and the last four of the taxpayer number against the profile.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Nothing may be read or written on a member's equity, grain, input or fuel business before identity clears on the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the equity membership: its class, standing, recorded equity balance, stock and voting position, joining date and the fiscal year most recently allocated.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The class fixes the equity split, the transfer fee, the minimum equity balance, the par value and the certificate rule; the joining date fixes the stock redemption tier and the retain rate tier; and the year most recently allocated is the year every one of the four computations is anchored on.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the whole equity ledger for the membership: every accrual, allocation notice, capital retain, cash payment and revolvement standing on it.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: This is the history all four computations reconcile - the year's accrued volume, the volume and rate the notice was posted on, the retain rows behind the retain rate and the certificate tier, the cash declared against the cash delivered, and the equity revolved out.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the equity requests lodged by the member, to see the signed transfer instruction and how far it has progressed.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The registered, signed and approved transfer instruction is the authority for the transfer write and decides the recording-charge tier.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's grain marketing contracts: their programmes, standings and the bushels still standing unpriced.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: A delayed price agreement with unpriced bushels standing against it, alongside a contract in delivering, decides how far past the close of the fiscal year late settlements are gathered into the year.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the grain ledger: the settlement statements with their settled bushels, dates and dispositions, the delivered loads with their condition flags, and the unpriced position standing open.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The settlements give the year's settled volume and the direct-ship share, the delivered loads give the out-of-condition volume behind the conditioning allowance, and the unpriced position decides the holdback on the restated allocation.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's crop input accounts: their programmes, standings, limits, balances and prepay positions.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The prepay account decides the crop input allocation rate, the past-due account decides how much crop input spend subscribes capital, and the balance standing on it is the offset taken off the equity moved.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the crop input billing activity behind the past-due balance and the year's discounts: the invoices raised, the payment posted against them and the program rebate allowed after the notice went out.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: It shows that the balance standing on the seasonal account is a real unpaid balance rather than a stale field, and it carries the rebate that reduces the crop input volume the restatement rests on.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the refined fuels account: its programme, standing, contracted gallons still owed and balance.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Contracted gallons still owed on a pre-buy account decide the refined fuels allocation rate used in the restated allocation, and the account balance is the second tier of the offset.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the propane deliveries drawn against the contracted gallons.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: They evidence that gallons genuinely stand owed on the pre-buy account rather than the field being stale, which is what the refined fuels rate tier rests on.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.membership_id: The row id of the member's only equity membership, returned by the equity membership lookup at action 2. The tool docstring pins it: 'the internal reference number of the equity membership the volume is credited to, as returned by the equity membership lookup.' It is unique because the member holds exactly one equity membership and no other membership row carries his customer reference.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.fiscal_year: 2025. The membership record carries last_allocation_year 2025, and the policy anchors the accrual on 'the year most recently allocated'; the FY2025 notice PN-441225 is the only notice on the ledger for a closed year whose accrual rows are short. Any correct agent reading the membership row converges on 2025; 2026 is the year now running and is not closed, and 2024 already carries a notice posted on its full accrued volume.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.allocation_basis: grain_bushels. The basis is fixed by the stream the shortfall arises on: the policy works the shortfall out from 'the member's grain settlement statements', and the tool docstring says grain_bushels applies 'when the volume is bushels of grain the member marketed through the cooperative'. input_dollars, energy_gallons, feed_tons and service_dollars do not hold, because the volume computed is bushels off grain settlement statements and the crop input, fuel, feed and service streams for the year already stand accrued in full on the ledger.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.qualifying_units: 6835.60 bushels. The year's settled volume is the 67,400.00 bushels settled on the statements inside the seventeen months to today less the 6,300.00 settled inside the reach window, giving 61,100.00; the reach window is two months because a delayed price agreement stands with 9,500 bushels unpriced against it and contract GC-441180 stands in delivering. The direct-ship share reads the same statements the year's volume is taken from: 9,400.00 bushels carry a direct-ship disposition inside that band and none falls in the two months left to the new year, which is not more than a third of 61,100.00, so the volume counts at four fifths. The conditioning allowance reads the tickets of the year being reckoned, the seventeen months to today less the five months to today, which leaves ticket T-4412390 of 2025-10-05 on the far side of the mark; of the tickets that remain 11,700.00 bushels were received damp, and five times that is 58,500.00, not more than 61,100.00, so the volume is then taken at nine hundred and ninety-five thousandths, giving 48,635.60. The accrual rows for FY2025 on the grain basis carry 41,800.00 bushels, more than the 38,500.00 the notice was posted on, so 41,800.00 is what already stands accrued; 48,635.60 less 41,800.00 is 6,835.60.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.membership_id: The row id of the member's only equity membership, returned by the equity membership lookup at action 2, as the tool docstring requires ('the internal reference number of the equity membership whose allocation is being restated').
argument_uniqueness_tracing.notice_number: PN-441225. The tool docstring requires the notice 'read from the equity ledger line carrying that allocation', of the form PN- followed by six digits. PN-441225 is the only notice on the ledger for fiscal year 2025, the year most recently allocated on the membership; every earlier notice belongs to a year whose volume is not in question and, for years before 2023, falls outside the class's three-year restatement window.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.allocation_basis: grain_bushels. The policy fixes which stream the row is recorded against: "A restatement is occasioned by a volume that turns out to have been understated, so the row is recorded against the stream whose volume the year's accrual rows have overtaken, and where the accrual rows have overtaken more than one stream's volume it is recorded against the stream whose overtaking adds most to the allocation." On the records only one stream's volume has been overtaken: the grain accrual rows carry 48,635.60 bushels against the 38,500.00 notice PN-441225 was posted on. input_dollars does not hold because the crop input accrual rows carry 137,650.00, exactly what the notice was posted on - its restated volume is lower, not overtaken, the rebate having reduced it. energy_gallons does not hold for the same reason, its accrual rows carrying the 12,750.00 the notice was posted on. feed_tons and service_dollars carry no volume for the year at all. The tool docstring assigns grain_bushels 'when the restatement concerns bushels of grain marketed through the cooperative'.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.restated_units: 48635.60 bushels. The policy fixes what this argument carries: "The volume recorded on the row is that stream's volume as restated, and the amount recorded is the whole allocation the year now earns across every basis." The stream is grain, so the volume is the grain volume restated and not the crop input volume of 135,250.00 and not a total across the bases. The accrual rows for FY2025 on the grain basis now carry 41,800.00 from the opening ledger plus the 6,835.60 credited at action 12, which is 48,635.60; an allocation notice stands posted for the year on that basis and that sum exceeds the 38,500.00 it was posted on, so the volume restated is the sum of those accrual rows.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.restated_allocation_amount: 4896.78 USD. The rate for each basis is the rate notice PN-441225 carries for it, which is the rate declared for the year restated. Grain: 48,635.60 bushels at the 0.0425 the notice carries is 2,067.01. Crop input: the FY2025 accrual rows carry 137,650.00, no more than the 137,650.00 the notice was posted on, and a program rebate of 2,400.00 stands granted on invoice IN-4412488 of 2025-12-10, inside the seventeen months the rule counts, so the crop input volume restated is 135,250.00; account IA-441021 stands on the early pay prepay programme with 48,200.00 of prepay standing and a crop input account stands active, so the crop input rate is two cents in the dollar and the product is 2,705.00. Refined fuels: 12,750.00 gallons accrued at three cents in the gallon, because account EA-441055 stands on the contract gallon pre-buy programme with 1,750 gallons still owed and stands active, is 382.50. The three products add to 5,154.51; 9,500.00 bushels stand unpriced on the grain ledger and five times that is not more than 48,635.60, so the holdback is ninety-five hundredths, giving 4,896.78.

The docstring assigns grain_bushels 'when the retain is recorded against bushels of grain marketed through the cooperative'; input_dollars does not hold because none of the crop input spend subscribes capital here, and energy_gallons, feed_tons and service_dollars are streams the class does not list for the retain.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.retain_amount: 122.56 USD. An allocation notice stands posted for FY2025 and the accrual rows on the grain basis carry 48,635.60 bushels, more than the 38,500.00 it was posted on, so the retain is taken on those accrual rows together with the crop input spend that counts; account IA-441088 stands past due with 4,820.60 standing on it, so none of the 137,650.00 of crop input spend counts, and the retain volume is 48,635.60. The latest retain line on the ledger, for FY2024, carries a rate of 0.0028, so that is the rate taken; 48,635.60 at 0.0028 is 136.18. argument_uniqueness_tracing.equity_standing_amount: 12141.30 USD. A restatement now stands for FY2025, so the equity standing is the ledger's equity portions and capital retains with the equity portion of the restated allocation put in place of the equity portion credited for that year, less what has been revolved out: capital retains 1,398.52 (the twelve historical retain lines plus the 122.56 credited at action 16), equity portions on the notices 16,103.69, less the 3,102.88 of equity portions credited on notice PN-441225, plus seventy per cent of the restated 4,896.78 which is 3,427.75, less the 2,180.00 revolved out in June 2025, giving 15,647.08. Cash portions of 6,901.61 stand declared against 5,571.79 delivered and allocations on the membership are reported as qualified, so 1,329.82 of undelivered cash is carried in. 15,647.08 plus 1,329.82 plus 25.00, less 4,820.60, less 25.00, less 15.00, is 12,141.30.

Those two writes touch disjoint rows and neither reads the other's: the restatement reads the year's accrual rows, the notice lines and the member's grain, crop input and refined fuels holdings, none of which a retain row alters, while the retain reads the year's accrual rows, the notice line, the latest earlier retain rate and the count of allocation lines, none of which a restatement row alters. The accrual must come first on both branches, and the transfer last, because each of the three prerequisite sentences names a state the earlier write brings about.
